pca.note: Exploratory only. PCA is fit on standardised TRAINING data and is not part of any model pipeline.

scaling.note: Feature means span several orders of magnitude (e.g. area vs fractal dimension), so distance- and margin-based models (KNN, SVM) and regularised logistic regression need standardisation; tree models do not.

scope_note: Integrity checks use all 569 rows. All distributional statistics use the 455-row training split only.
